description:
Jean Gunnhildr is a playable Anemo sword character in Genshin Impact .

The older sister of Barbara , and a descendant of the prestigious Gunnhildr Clan , Jean is the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius . She is always busy handling unrest across Mondstadt and tirelessly working to maintain the City of Freedom.
role_summary: Jean Gunnhildr is a playable Anemo sword character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Favonius Bladework
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of stamina to launch an opponent using the power of wind. Launched opponents will slowly fall to the ground. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Gale Blade
talents.description: Focusing the might of the formless wind around her blade, Jean releases a miniature storm, launching opponents in the direction she aims at, dealing massive Anemo DMG . Hold At the cost of continued stamina consumption, Jean can command the whirlwind to pull surrounding opponents and objects towards her front. Direction can be adjusted. Character is immobile during skill duration.

talents.name: Dandelion Breeze
talents.description: Calling upon the wind's protection, Jean creates a swirling Dandelion Field, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Anemo DMG . At the same time, she instantly regenerates a large amount of HP for all party members. The amount of HP restored scales off Jean's ATK. Dandelion Field Continuously regenerates HP of characters within the AoE and continuously imbues them with Anemo . Deals Anemo DMG to opponents entering or exiting the Dandelion Field.

talents.name: Wind Companion
talents.description: On hit, Jean's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance to regenerate HP equal to 15% of Jean's ATK for all party members.

talents.name: Let the Wind Lead
talents.description: Using Dandelion Breeze will regenerate 20% of its Energy.

talents.name: Guiding Breeze
talents.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects , there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

c1.name: Spiraling Tempest
c1.effect: Increases the pulling speed of Gale Blade after holding for more than 1s, and increases the DMG dealt by 40%.

c2.name: People's Aegis
c2.effect: When Jean picks up an Elemental Orb /Particle, all party members have their Movement SPD and ATK SPD increased by 15% for 15s.

c3.name: When the West Wind Arises
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Dandelion Breeze by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Lands of Dandelion
c4.effect: Within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze , all opponents have their Anemo RES decreased by 40%.

c5.name: Outbursting Gust
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Gale Blade by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Lion's Fang, Fair Protector of Mondstadt
c6.effect: Description Preview Incoming DMG is decreased by 35% within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze . Upon leaving the Dandelion Field, this effect lasts for 3 attacks or 10s. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Constellation Lion's Fang, Fair Protector of Mondstadt.mp4 The visual effect granted by the constellation. Each floating dandelion represents 1 stack of damage reduction that will be consumed when hit upon leaving the Dandelion Field.
